item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
• Karaoke stays with your voice: the highlight now leads the recognizer so it sits on the word you are saying, glides at your reading pace between results, and when you pause it settles on the last word you said instead of running ahead. Prompter settings, Karaoke, Timing: Behind, In line or Ahead.
  • Fade and highlight are independent: dim what you have read without a highlight, or highlight without the fade.
  • Pill highlight: a rounded pill around the current word, with its own text color. Prompter settings, Karaoke, Style.
  • Which microphone is listening: while following, the status line under the prompter preview names the device. Recognition uses your system language and region.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
• Run the prompter from your phone: PowerCue Companion 1.0.2 adds Follow, Play/Pause, Back to Top and marker buttons, and stays awake while prompting. If its microphone cannot listen, the phone says why.
  • Language of the script: Settings, Speech Recognition. Pick the language you read in; the Mac and the iPhone microphone both recognize it. Only on-device languages are offered.
  • The marker arrow is a handle: drag it to move the marker. It is bigger by default, goes much bigger, sits flush against the edge, and can live on the right side.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
• Scroll from your phone: drag the script on the iPhone or iPad companion and the Mac prompter follows your finger. Play pauses while you drag and resumes where you let go; during Follow, letting go re-anchors the voice tracking right there. Needs PowerCue Companion 1.0.1 from the App Store.
  • Smarter crash reports: Send Crash Reports now attaches only reports from this app and this version (or the last week), each labeled with the version that crashed.
  • Companion sync is more robust when the script changes while a device is connected.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
• PowerCue Companion is on the App Store: the free iPhone and iPad app that mirrors your prompter in lock-step and can act as your microphone. Settings now links straight to it, under iPhone & iPad Companion.
  • Small fixes and polish.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
• PowerCue Companion for iPhone and iPad — mirror the prompter to your phone or tablet over local Wi-Fi, in perfect lock-step: same line breaks, styling, karaoke highlight, and on-screen timer. Turn it on under the display menu; the companion app is coming to the App Store.
  • Your iPhone as the microphone — pick "iPhone/iPad Microphone" in the mic menu and the phone in front of you drives voice following, with recognition staying on the device.
  • Prompter mode in the editor — the Prompter tab now styles the edit page exactly like the prompter (same line breaks, markers, timecodes) while staying a full text editor.
  • Font menu in the editor — the same font picker as the prompter, and Helvetica as the fresh-start default.
  • Timer button — show or hide the on-screen timer right from the control bar.
  • Voice following is more resilient — if macOS speech recognition fails mid-session, PowerCue now reconnects automatically instead of stalling.
  • A styled starter script that shows off markers and formatting, and assorted fixes.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
• The prompter now leads you — the line you are about to read rests at the marker, so finishing a line advances the scroll immediately instead of waiting for your next word.
  • Voice following starts faster — and no longer drops words spoken across recognition boundaries, so it never loses you after a pause.
  • Play fixed at slow speeds — long run times and slow per-line speeds used to freeze the scroll in place; it now glides smoothly at any pace.
  • A guided tour — offered on first launch and replayable any time from Help → Take the Tour.
  • A real Settings window — microphone, automatic updates, help and feedback, and your license, under ⌘,.
  • Close toggles for the markers panel and the prompter preview, and a fresh starter script.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
PowerCue 1.0 — the teleprompter that follows your voice.

  • Voice following with on-device speech recognition: pause and it waits, ad-lib and it re-anchors.
  • Karaoke highlight, jump markers, screen directions, and a fully styled dark-mode script editor.
  • Detachable prompter window with full mirror flips for beam-splitter rigs.
  • On-screen timer, run-time pacing with per-paragraph estimates, Word import and export.
